title: Poorest countries by GDP per capita
subtitle: 1960 to 2025 GDP per capita ranking
hook: Explore the historical trajectory of global economies over six decades.
setup: This race visualizes GDP per capita rankings from 1960 to 2025, highlighting shifting economic standings across nations.

sequence.text: Switzerland takes the initial lead in 1960 with a GDP per capita of 36,945.47 USD.
Iceland enters the rankings in 1965 at rank 10 with a value of 19,538.98 USD.
Qatar makes a dramatic entrance in 1969, immediately seizing the top rank with 79,709.48 USD.
The United Arab Emirates captures the lead in 1973, reaching 107,395.10 USD.
Switzerland reclaims the top position in 1986 with a value of 65,532.80 USD.
Luxembourg takes over the lead in 1991, registering 70,783.80 USD.
Ireland appears on the leaderboard in 1999 at rank 9 with 42,599.48 USD.
Singapore joins the rankings in 2009 at rank 10 with a GDP per capita of 48,752.05 USD.

highlights.headline: Switzerland Leads
highlights.detail: Switzerland begins the period in 1960 at the top of the ranking.

factBox.heading: Top Economy
factBox.body: Switzerland holds the leading GDP per capita in 1960.

ending: Over six decades, the rankings reflect significant economic shifts among the leading nations.
